findings.message: No primary protocol evidence is present in the packet. The packet carries only the criteria text, the artifact metadata, and the candidate row. There is no protocol page, no served-value summary, and no added/changed count, so the registry version, benchmark identity, metric, units and description cannot be verified against the actual current primary protocol. Identity continuity cannot be established.

No protocol text is present to check status, version_status, and superseded_by. There is no way to determine whether the maintainer still reports results, whether a release identifier is published, or whether a successor board is named. The lifecycle fields cannot be verified.

missing_evidence: actual current primary protocol page for the board (its text on the task set, harness, judges, version and lifecycle)
this run's generated summary of the finite values served today for the board's source field (count, lowest, highest)
this run's generated summary of how many model rows' values were added or changed in today's captured payload compared with the previously published snapshot
notes: The frozen artifact content is the JSON of the single candidate row. The row's own identity hash (6342b1a865f4bdbe27585afa1fb1ba37804a3c2a81c647dd9d4aacf45eec2c07) is taken as binding; no hash recomputation was attempted. No primary evidence was supplied in the packet, so neither criterion can be settled.
